subject: Echelon BioWorks — MAP & purchase sequencing for AWS Private Offer
content:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@echelonbioworks.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Echelon MAP draft + proposed sequencing for AWS Private Offer

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan focused on closing via an AWS Private Offer and the acceptance/billing sequence so your procurement team has a clear playbook. Attaching: ECH-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and a one-pager on how Private Offers route through marketplace billing.

High-level proposed milestones (first pass):
- Week 0 (Apr 8): 14-day evaluation window starts — access to test tenant + sample dataset.
- Week 2 (Apr 22): Technical acceptance gate — run the acceptance checklist (SLA smoke tests, latency p99 checks, sample prompts).
- Week 3 (Apr 29): Finalize PO details and send AWS Private Offer contract to Echelon (billing to AP@echelon).
- Week 4 (May 6): Private Offer accepted in AWS; invoice issued by marketplace; Redwood standby for onboarding and post-acceptance support.

Open items I’d like your input on so we can finalize:
1) Preferred invoicing terms (NET30/NET60) and billing contact.
2) Any specific acceptance criteria we should add to the technical checklist.
3) If Echelon requires additional compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report or data residency statements).

If that sequencing looks reasonable I’ll loop in Aditya (solutions engineering) and Kimberly (legal) to lock SOW and private-offer language.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: ECH-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-private-offer-summary.pdf (one-pager)

---

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@echelonbioworks.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@echelonbioworks.com>, procurement@echelonbioworks.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2029 13:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Echelon MAP draft + proposed sequencing for AWS Private Offer

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear draft. A few procurement/finance questions before we nail dates: 
- Echelon typically issues NET60 POs. Can Redwood accommodate NET60 on the marketplace invoice or would that require a different purchase path?
- Our AP team requires the invoice to include a PO number and billing contact (AP team: ap@echelonbioworks.com).
- We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short data residency statement confirming that customer data for the evaluation will remain in the us-west-2 region. Can you provide those?

On acceptance criteria: the technical team wants the following added to the checklist — model reproducibility for a 50-prompt set and end-to-end latency measurements for 1k token sequences.

I’m looping Sanjay from procurement — he’ll lead the PO path.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Head of Product, Echelon BioWorks

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@echelonbioworks.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Apr 2029 08:22:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Echelon MAP draft + proposed sequencing for AWS Private Offer

Marta / Sanjay —

Thanks — good questions. Quick answers and a revised sequencing attached (ECH-MAP-v2.xlsx):

- Invoicing / NET terms: Marketplace Private Offers are invoiced by AWS and generally follow marketplace billing cadence; AWS marketplace invoices typically carry NET30. We can accept NET60 only via a direct contract (Dedicated/Reserved capacity agreement) outside the marketplace. If NET60 is a hard requirement, we can propose a hybrid: complete the Private Offer for procurement simplicity, then add a short Redwood Commercial Addendum that allows NET60 on our side — legal/finance will need to review.

- PO on invoice: AWS will include the PO number if provided at time of purchase. Please confirm the PO number field when you submit acceptance in the Private Offer UI — we’ll also include an invoice reference in the PO you return. Marcus is copied to confirm Redwood’s internal finance workflow so the invoice maps cleanly to your PO.

- Compliance/artifacts: Attached is a redwood-private-offer-summary.pdf with data residency notes; Kimberly will follow up with SOC 2 evidence via secure share. For the evaluation we can pin the test tenant to us-west-2 and provide a signed data processing addendum (DPA).

- Acceptance checklist updates: We added the reproducibility check (50-prompt run) and 1k-token p99 latency test as requested. See ECH-MAP-v2.xlsx for dates and owners.

Proposed revised milestones (dates updated in attachment):
- Apr 8: Eval access provisioned (Aditya leads, test tenant in us-west-2).
- Apr 8–21: 14-day eval window — engineering completes reproducibility & latency tests.
- Apr 22: Technical acceptance sign-off (Echelon engineering + Redwood SE).
- Apr 23–Apr 29: Procurement executes Private Offer acceptance and transmits PO number.
- May 1: Expected AWS invoice generation (NET30) — if NET60 required, target contract addendum sign by May 15.

Next steps I propose: Marcus will confirm our finance flexibility by EOD Thursday; Kimberly will send SOC 2 and the DPA link; Aditya will schedule the eval access for Apr 8.

Evelyn

---

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@echelonbioworks.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@echelonbioworks.com>
Cc: procurement@echelonbioworks.com
Date: Thu, 04 Apr 2029 11:09:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Echelon MAP draft + proposed sequencing for AWS Private Offer

Evelyn / team —

Confirming internal timeline: we can issue PO the week of Apr 23 provided technical acceptance occurs on Apr 22. Our AP team requires the PO number field to be present on the AWS invoice and for the invoice to reference our company EIN and billing address. I’m attaching our PO template (Echelon-PO-template.docx).

Regarding NET60 — I’ll escalate to finance but cannot promise before PO issuance. If NET60 is necessary we may need a short-term workaround (submit the PO, pay per AWS terms, then execute a commercial addendum post-close).

Please prepare a DocuSign SOW that includes: precise SKU/commit amounts for the Private Offer, billing contact, and the acceptance checklist as an exhibit.

Sanjay Rao
Procurement Manager
Echelon BioWorks
attachments: Echelon-PO-template.docx

Subject: Re: Echelon MAP draft + proposed sequencing for AWS Private Offer — Next steps

Team — quick status + action items so nothing slips: 

Action owners (short):
- Aditya: provision test tenant in us-west-2 and share credentials by EOD Apr 5 (will also post acceptance checklist in Drive).
- Kimberly: upload SOC 2 Type II redacted report to secure share and send DPA link by Apr 6.
- Marcus: confirm Redwood finance position re NET60 / NET30 and whether we can surface a commercial addendum by Apr 4.
- Sanjay: confirm PO template fields and let us know if AP requires additional line items.
- Marta: confirm the PO number at time of Private Offer acceptance (target Apr 23).

Links: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-98765
- DocuSign SOW (draft to follow): https://docusign.net/secure/doc/abc123-ech-po
- Updated MAP (v2): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/ECH-MAP-v2

If everyone signs off we’ll treat Apr 22 technical acceptance as the gating milestone for PO issuance and aim for May 1 invoice generation via AWS marketplace. If NET60 becomes a blocker we’ll prepare the addendum workflow as discussed.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign SOW draft Monday morning so procurement has something to attach to the PO.

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
